personal.hook: Use industry keywords in your social bios for better discovery.
personal.photocard_text: Optimize your social profiles for search by including relevant industry keywords.
personal.caption: Social media platforms are functioning more like search engines every day. Users do not just browse feeds; they type specific terms into the search bar to find products, services, and creators. If your display name and bio only feature your brand name, you are missing out on organic discovery. To fix this, append your primary niche keyword directly next to your business name. For example, instead of just 'Acme Co', use 'Acme Co | SaaS Marketing'. At HelloFides, we optimize every client profile to ensure they show up when target buyers search for their specific category. It takes two minutes to update, but it compounds over time as search traffic grows. Take a look at your profiles today and make this simple adjustment.
